github_pr_template.description:
Initialize persistent governance for Claude working on APEX runtime.

## What
- Created CLAUDE.md root governance
- Created .claude/settings.json with safety constraints
- Created .claude/rules/ with 6 comprehensive governance rule files
- Created .claude/README.md explaining the framework

## Why
- Ensures Claude operates under APEX Constitutional constraints
- Establishes evidence classification and proof requirements
- Preserves tenant isolation and least-privilege access
- Enables worker continuity and memory governance
- Makes governance version-controlled and reviewable

## How to Review
- Read CLAUDE.md for overview
- Read .claude/README.md for usage guide
- Read individual rule files for detailed policies
- Verify JSON: `jq . .claude/settings.json`
- Check for secrets: `grep -r password .claude CLAUDE.md`

## Safety
- No real secrets committed
- No production code modified
- Backward-compatible (doesn't break existing work)
- All existing governance preserved
